//: Separate from the repo tsconfig on purpose. The repo uses NodeNext, which requires .js suffixes on relative imports; wrangler bundles with esbuild, which resolves extensionless imports to .ts. That difference is why this file exists — it lets scan.ts import the REAL parseWeight from src/core/stores/weight rather than keeping a second copy of it.
//exclude: The test is NODE code, not Worker code, so it is checked by tsconfig.test.json — which is the only config that adds @types/node. Keeping it out of here is what stops a Node-only API from typechecking clean here and then failing at the edge.
